purpose: Pre-register FireSense v0 project-policy performance thresholds for a compatible independent external holdout dataset.
interpretation: These are FireSense project release-policy thresholds, not universal combustion-science acceptance limits.
The thresholds are frozen before evaluating future real independent validation evidence.
Passing quantitative thresholds does not replace source-provenance review.
Passing validation does not imply certification or production readiness.
